facts.content: Patient has continuous vertigo for approximately 2 hours with sensations of the room spinning.
facts.source_text: CC: Continuous vertigo x ~2 hrs; room spinning

facts.content: Vertigo onset was sudden while making breakfast.
Associated symptoms include nausea, ear buzzing (tinnitus), and gait unsteadiness due to vertigo.
facts.source_text: Assoc: Nausea; ear buzzing (tinnitus); gait unsteadiness due to vertigo

facts.content: Denies vomiting, fever, upper respiratory infection symptoms, ear pain or discharge, hearing loss, and limb weakness.
facts.source_text: Denies: Vomiting, fever, URI sxs, ear pain/discharge, hearing loss, limb weakness

facts.content: Experienced a similar brief episode of vertigo about 1 month ago lasting 5 to 10 minutes.
facts.source_text: Prior similar episode ~1 mo ago lasting 5–10 min

facts.content: Patient has a history of premature ovarian failure.
Patient is on hormone replacement therapy (HRT).
Patient has no known drug allergies.
The assessment is acute continuous vertigo with tinnitus, no hearing loss or neurological deficits, likely peripheral (labyrinthitis/vestibular neuritis).
facts.source_text: Acute continuous vertigo with tinnitus, no hearing loss or neuro deficits — likely peripheral (labyrinthitis/vestibular neuritis).

facts.content: There was a prior brief episode 1 month ago.
Start vestibular suppressant/antiemetic as per prescription sent to pharmacy; 1 tablet three times daily for 10 days.
facts.source_text: Start vestibular suppressant/antiemetic per Rx sent to pharmacy (1 tab TID x10 days)

facts.content: Arrange in-person evaluation for otoscopic exam, blood pressure, gait, and neurological assessment.
facts.source_text: Arrange in-person evaluation: otoscopic exam, BP, gait/neurologic assessment

facts.content: Safety net: Visit A&E if there are new limb weaknesses, severe or sudden headache, intractable vomiting, or worsening symptoms.
facts.source_text: Safety net: A&E if new limb weakness, severe/sudden headache, intractable vomiting, worsening symptoms

facts.content: Patient to book appointment via support.
facts.source_text: Patient to book appointment via support

facts.content: Patient may take medication with or without food as tolerated.
facts.source_text: May take medication with or without food as tolerated
